subject: Pilot readiness checkpoint — success criteria, test plan, blockers
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Sara Miller <sara.miller@acme-retail.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 07 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot readiness checkpoint — success criteria, test plan, blockers

Hi all,

Thanks again for joining today's weekly MAP check. Below is a concise roll-up of decisions, the evaluation plan we've agreed to for the pilot, and outstanding blockers. Please reply with any corrections.

Summary (quick):
- Pilot window: 2027-06-14 -> 2027-06-28 (two-week run)
- Primary acceptance criteria: see table in attached MAP_v1.3.xlsx (tokens/latency/cost thresholds + functional correctness on 3 canonical prompts)
- Primary blocker: scoped data access (S3 read roles) and SOC2 evidence request for audit team

Action items (owners & target dates):
1) Aditya: finalize pilot test harness and share pilot-test-plan.md by 2027-06-09 (includes eval scripts + scoring).
2) Markus: coordinate infra creds with Acme SRE + schedule VPN cutover; target 2027-06-11.
3) Grace: prepare monitoring dashboard template in Console and pre-populate a cost/latency baseline; target 2027-06-12.
4) Acme (Sara / procurement): confirm procurement sign-off (PO or MSA addendum) and confirm SOC2 evidence window; target 2027-06-10.

Acceptance criteria highlights (from MAP_v1.3):
- Latency P95 <= 350ms for 512-token average sequences under reserved throughput.
- Generation quality: >= 85% pass rate on the 3 canonical prompt tests (sourced from Acme test set).
- Cost: token-based unit cost not to exceed the committed pilot rate in SOW.

Blockers / Risks:
- Data access: Acme needs to provide a temporary read-only S3 role; until then we cannot run end-to-end samples.
- Security evidence: Acme's audit team requested additional SOC2 artifacts (see attached PDF).
- Model variant decision: If the quantized variant impacts quality, we may need a fallback to the float variant which affects cost baseline.

Attachments: MAP_v1.3.xlsx, pilot-test-plan.md, SOC2-evidence-request.pdf

Next checkpoint: Friday 2027-06-11 10:00 PT across the same thread — goal is to confirm all open items are green.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Senior Solutions Manager, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0129

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Sara Miller <sara.miller@acme-retail.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 08 Jun 2027 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot readiness checkpoint — success criteria, test plan, blockers

Thanks Monica — quick technical status update from my side.

On Mon, Jun 7, 2027 at 09:12 AM Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com> wrote:
> Thanks again for joining today's weekly MAP check....

What I completed today:
- Drafted the pilot-test-plan.md and pushed to the shared Drive link (see related_links). It includes the eval harness, scoring script, and synthetic load generator.
- Local run of canonical prompts matches baseline for generation quality at ~87% for the float variant.

Immediate blocker (needs action from Acme):
- We need a temporary S3 role ARN with read-only access to the 'acme-prod-samples/pilot' bucket. Without that, we cannot run the end-to-end sampling that validates embeddings and reranking.

Workaround options if role is delayed:
- Run using a small sample dataset mirrored to Redwood test S3 bucket (requires NDA/consent from Acme to copy subset).
- Limit pilot scope to synthetic inputs (doesn't validate reranking or ingestion).

Questions for Acme: can you provide the role ARN and a contact for your SRE? If procurement needs a brief template for the minimal access statement, I can put that together today.

Thanks,
Aditya
Principal ML Engineer, Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.com

From: Sara Miller <sara.miller@acme-retail.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@acme-retail.com
Date: Wed, 09 Jun 2027 08:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot readiness checkpoint — success criteria, test plan, blockers

Thanks, Monica and Aditya — appreciate the clear action list. A few notes from our side: 

- Procurement: I’ve looped in our procurement mailbox. We'll try to have a PO or addendum ready by 2027-06-10 but we may need an MSA clause amendment.
- S3 role: Our SRE (cc'd below in a follow-up) needs a minimal access spec. Aditya — please send the short template you mentioned.
- SOC2 artifacts: Our audit team reviewed the SOC2-evidence-request.pdf you attached. They will expect a 5-business-day window to validate control mappings. That pushes timeline on evidence back slightly if they need live runbooks.

Acceptance criteria confirmation:
- Acme confirms the three canonical prompt tests are representative. We'll hand-pick an additional 20 items to stress test edge cases during week 1.

Small ask: can Redwood host a short troubleshooting war room on 2027-06-15 09:00 PT in case we hit onboarding issues during ramp?

Sara Miller

Status snapshot:
- Aditya: pilot-test-plan.md uploaded; we have float variant quality ~87% and will evaluate quantized impact during the run. (Owner: Aditya; status: in progress)
- Markus: SRE coordination in progress — Acme to share SRE contact + role ARN by EOD Monday (Owner: Markus; due: 2027-06-14).
- Grace: dashboard template ready for pre-population; will push to Console and share link by Monday. (Owner: Grace; due: 2027-06-14)
- Acme / Procurement: PO / MSA update in flight; Sara will escalate if timeline slips. (Owner: Acme; status: pending)

Confirmed next steps:
- If role ARN arrives by 2027-06-14 morning we will begin end-to-end sampling the same day.
- War room for onboarding confirmed: 2027-06-15 09:00 PT (Zoom link to follow).
- Friday 2027-06-18 10:00 PT will be the next MAP checkpoint to review week-1 results and any acceptance deviations.

If there are no objections I’ll update MAP_v1.3.xlsx with the owners/due dates and re-share.
